invariants.title: Every crate lands where the simulation put it
invariants.rule: The fall is choreographed in Blender and drawn over its depth.
invariants.why: It is the one beat whose physics we decide instead of hope for; Seedance would invent it from words.

invariants.title: The aisle ends blocked
invariants.rule: The pile closes the aisle completely - he cannot come through.
invariants.why: The rest of the film stands on that wall.

invariants.title: The start frame is the simulation's
invariants.rule: The first frame is the dressed previz frame, not a composed one.
invariants.why: The depth guide and the picture must agree from frame one or the crates swim.

flair.title: Take
flair.note: pv:3003 - the plume of dust at the impact; the same motion agreement as seed 11 (r 0.918)

title: the fall
beat: The tower of crates topples across the aisle and bursts on the floor, a wall of broken wood between them. Hale stands beyond it.

build.script: Blender physics, drawn through LTX-2.3 depth control (74); start frame the simulation's first frame, dressed by Qwen-Image-2.1 · take pv:3003
